card.name: Added/also after a speaker or subject
card.fires_on: The verb 'added' or 'adds' right after a quoted speaker (he, she, study authors). Also 'also', 'well' or 'too' where an extra point is tacked on.

modes.label: Quote attribution
modes.description: 'added' or 'adds' after a speaker pronoun or name, introducing a further remark.
modes.example: he<< added>>. The DEC said it would flexible because

modes.label: Additive adverbs
modes.description: 'also', 'well' or 'too' that add another fact to the sentence.
modes.example: Symptoms may<< also>> subside and then reappear later.

card.writes: It suppresses 'also' and similar words in several languages, so the model does not add another 'also' here.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a writer adds one more point, mostly 'he added' after a quote.
